posts.text: If you are looking for a free LLM API to develop maybe a prototype of your AI product, or just casually build an AI project for your practice, instead of using self hosted model on @ollama , you can surely try @GoogleAIStudio, they provide decent models like @GeminiApp 2.5 flash. https://t.co/gxk4zffWme

LACK is SLACK for OLLAMA models: local usage and non stop looping. Always wanted your own team of agents? 

It's easier than you think, and free. LACK makes it simple - one python megalith abstracts an endless number of @OLLAMA agents: https://t.co/7UroXSbJZL https://t.co/CES6SPRdUk
@HimanshuJasaiw1 @ollama not sure, I run it free locally and just assumed hosted inference or enterprise support down the line

@ollama limited cloud free models.
Now I can’t use vision models anymore. can i?

@TheAIShrink @ycombinator @ollama @jmorgan A free trial ends though -- this compounds. Every enterprise workload validated on a local model this year is one fewer RFP a closed lab gets invited to next year. What timeline would you put on that flipping majority?

@ycombinator @ollama @jmorgan Open source models are the free trial. Jeffrey Morgan isn’t counting users, he’s capturing switching costs before walled gardens notice what they already lost.

free is expensive once you’re locked in

@raycast @OpenRouter @ollama to run a local ollama model in ai chat, required pro subscription now? why? it was free in v1, and since the model is running on my machine, what is the cost there for Raycast?
@Boogie_Software @ComfyUI @ollama @vllm_project This project is moving nicely, feel free to reach out anytime 🤝
